Use case: scientific-educational, style-transfer. The recent screenshots contain our existing three DDPM tutorial diagrams embedded in GitHub. Redraw ONLY the diagram specified below, not the browser or article. Create a finished wide landscape raster illustration for a Chinese beginner tutorial, around 2:1 aspect ratio. Consistent editorial illustration style: warm ivory paper, sage green, deep teal, terracotta roof, subtle tactile cut paper and gentle soft 3D shading, crisp generous whitespace, mature friendly science textbook not corporate flowchart. House is a tiny cream cottage with terracotta triangular roof, teal door, two windows, pale green lawn and yellow sun. Large perfectly legible simplified Chinese labels, few words. All arrows unambiguous, no decorations that confuse direction, no invented formulas. This is a conceptual teaching illustration, not experimental evidence. Footer exact small text: “概念示意，非模型实测”.
EDIT TARGET: the first cover diagram (house progressively obscured by noise). Preserve its scientific meaning. Title “DDPM：从一张小房子开始”. Four large square image panels left to right with the SAME cottage composition. Panel1 clean recognizable cottage; panel2 that exact picture partially corrupted by fine random multicolor/grayscale pixel noise with recognizable house; panel3 mostly stochastic noise with very faint silhouette; panel4 pure random grain with NO house visible. Three clean teal arrows pointing RIGHT. Labels below panels exactly “原图”, “少量噪声”, “大量噪声”, “几乎全是噪声”. Lower caption “加噪：图像信号逐渐减弱”. Make noise look stochastic image noise, not fog or smoke; preserve conceptual progressive signal destruction. No reverse arrow or recovering original claim.

EDIT TARGET: second training diagram. Title “训练：我们出题，也知道答案”. Spacious accurate information flow. Left cluster: a cottage picture labelled “原图”, plus sign, a noise tile labelled “已知噪声”; arrows merge into a visibly NOISY cottage picture labelled “带噪图”. From that noisy picture arrow into a teal soft dimensional module labelled “去噪网络”; a small separate tag “噪声等级” points to this network. Network outputs a noise tile labelled “预测噪声”. A lower comparison area labelled “比较误差” receives arrows from both the original known-noise tile and the predicted-noise tile. Then a feedback arrow labelled “调整参数” returns from comparison area to network. The clean original and known noise must NOT directly go into the network; they create the noisy input and the noise answer is used to compare outputs. Keep text limited to specified labels, exact. Arrange entire flow to avoid crossings and ensure all labels readable. Cottage is visual content in original/noisy input, output is predicted noise, not a cottage. This diagram explains one training example.

Main flow from LEFT noise square labelled “随机噪声” into central large calm sage rounded region containing a stylized teal network module and short label “预测噪声 → 更新图像”. A clean loop arrow BELOW this central region returning back INTO same region labelled “重复多次”. Main flow continues RIGHT to a new cottage image labelled “一张新图”. Extra caption below “生成时，不提供原图”. Use the same friendly cottage design and subtle paper/shadow finish as other diagrams. Distinguish main left-to-right flow from feedback loop. Never show clean reference as input, never imply recovering an original hidden image, do not make output appear directly after just one network pass: the loop must be visually prominent. Include small supporting text “中间步骤保留少量随机性” inside central region.
